title: Beast contracts
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.name: Blood Contract
items.told: You open your palm and it opens its mouth, and the blood runs both ways. %s is bound to you by blood now: what it gives, it gives more.

items.name: Soul Contract
items.told: For a moment you see out of its eyes, and it out of yours. %s shares your soul's weather now -- it knows what you want before you do.

items.name: Heaven Contract
items.told: The sky whispers your name to it, and %s hears. Bound by the heavens, your paths will forever be entwined, beyond life's end.
